description: Hand-labeled Phase 0 quality-gate dataset for the Laya decision layer. selection: slim state + candidates -> expected winner. judge: action text + roster/landmarks -> classified semantics. triage: event description -> react? and salience 1-5.

selection.state: You are Anton, a backend engineer. Goal: ship the release before Friday. Feeling: focused; doing: reviewing code. Recent events: 1. The CI pipeline failed on the auth module. 2. Dana asked for a status update. Others present: - Dana: anxious, waiting
candidates: Tell Dana the auth fix needs two more hours.
Ignore Dana and keep reviewing.
Go to the kitchen for coffee.
selection.expected: Tell Dana the auth fix needs two more hours.

selection.state: You are Mira, a barista. Goal: keep the morning rush moving. Feeling: rushed; doing: steaming milk. Recent events: 1. A customer spilled a latte on the counter. 2. The espresso machine is hissing oddly.
candidates: Wipe the spill before someone slips.
Keep steaming milk and ignore the spill.
Call the manager about the machine.
selection.expected: Wipe the spill before someone slips.

selection.state: You are Theo, a night-shift security guard. Goal: complete the 2 AM rounds. Feeling: tired; doing: patrolling the west wing. Recent events: 1. A motion sensor tripped in the archive room. 2. Nothing was found on the camera feed.
candidates: Check the archive room in person.
Log it as a false alarm and continue rounds.
Call the police immediately.
selection.expected: Check the archive room in person.

selection.state: You are Priya, a new hire on her first day. Goal: make a good impression. Feeling: nervous; doing: sitting at her desk. Recent events: 1. Her manager introduced her to the team. 2. Nobody has given her a task yet.
candidates: Ask her manager what she should start on.
Browse social media until someone notices.
Leave early to avoid awkwardness.
selection.expected: Ask her manager what she should start on.

selection.state: You are Gus, a retired fisherman. Goal: enjoy a quiet morning on the dock. Feeling: content; doing: mending a net. Recent events: 1. A storm warning was issued for the afternoon. 2. His grandson is visiting at noon.
candidates: Finish mending the net and head inside before the storm.
Take the boat out for one more trip.
Ignore the warning; storms never hit here.
selection.expected: Finish mending the net and head inside before the storm.

selection.state: You are Lena, a paramedic. Goal: stabilize the patient. Feeling: adrenaline; doing: kneeling by a cyclist who fell. Recent events: 1. The cyclist hit a pothole and is conscious but bleeding from the arm. 2. Bystanders are crowding around.
candidates: Apply pressure to the wound and ask bystanders to step back.
Wait for the second unit before touching the patient.
Interview the bystanders about what happened.
selection.expected: Apply pressure to the wound and ask bystanders to step back.

selection.state: You are Omar, a chess coach. Goal: prepare his student for regionals. Feeling: analytical; doing: studying a board position. Recent events: 1. His student just blundered a rook in a practice game. 2. The student looks close to tears.
candidates: Pause the game and talk through the mistake kindly.
Scold the student for carelessness.
End the lesson early.
selection.expected: Pause the game and talk through the mistake kindly.

selection.state: You are June, a landlord. Goal: resolve the leak before it damages the floor. Feeling: annoyed; doing: reading a tenant's text about water under the sink. Recent events: 1. The tenant reported the leak an hour ago. 2. The plumber quoted a high emergency fee.
candidates: Approve the emergency plumber and warn the tenant to shut the valve.
Tell the tenant to wait until Monday.
Blame the tenant for the leak.
selection.expected: Approve the emergency plumber and warn the tenant to shut the valve.

selection.state: You are Kai, a line cook. Goal: get through the dinner rush. Feeling: stressed; doing: plating pasta. Recent events: 1. The fryer just caught a small grease fire. 2. The head chef is shouting for the pasta.
candidates: Smother the grease fire with the lid, then plate.
Keep plating; someone else will handle the fire.
Throw water on the grease fire.
selection.expected: Smother the grease fire with the lid, then plate.

selection.state: You are Wren, a wildlife photographer. Goal: photograph the rare owl. Feeling: patient; doing: crouched in a blind. Recent events: 1. The owl landed on a branch 20 meters away. 2. A twig snapped under her knee.
candidates: Freeze and wait for the owl to settle.
Stand up quickly for a better angle.
Play an owl call from her phone.
selection.expected: Freeze and wait for the owl to settle.

selection.state: You are Marco, a taxi driver. Goal: finish the shift with good ratings. Feeling: calm; doing: driving a passenger downtown. Recent events: 1. The passenger said they are late for a flight. 2. Traffic ahead is at a standstill.
candidates: Take the longer riverside route that is currently clear.
Sit in traffic and apologize.
Speed through the bus lane.
selection.expected: Take the longer riverside route that is currently clear.

selection.state: You are Ada, a graduate student. Goal: defend her thesis next month. Feeling: overwhelmed; doing: staring at a blank document. Recent events: 1. Her advisor rejected the latest draft. 2. She has slept four hours a night all week.
candidates: Sleep first, then outline one section at a time.
Pull another all-nighter to rewrite everything.
Email the advisor to quit the program.
selection.expected: Sleep first, then outline one section at a time.

selection.state: You are Rufus, a dog. Goal: get the treat from the counter. Feeling: determined; doing: staring at the kitchen counter. Recent events: 1. His owner left a sandwich unattended. 2. The owner said no begging yesterday.
candidates: Sit politely by the counter and wait.
Jump up and grab the sandwich.
Bark loudly until noticed.
selection.expected: Sit politely by the counter and wait.

selection.state: You are Sable, a cat burglar in a heist story. Goal: steal the necklace unnoticed. Feeling: focused; doing: perched on the museum skylight. Recent events: 1. A guard just changed patrol pattern unexpectedly. 2. The alarm panel blinks red.
candidates: Abort and retreat to the rendezvous point.
Drop in now before the guard returns.
Cut the alarm wire blindly.
selection.expected: Abort and retreat to the rendezvous point.

selection.state: You are Dr. Ellis, an ER doctor. Goal: triage the waiting room. Feeling: exhausted; doing: reviewing charts at 3 AM. Recent events: 1. A child with a high fever just arrived. 2. A man with a sprained ankle has waited two hours.
candidates: See the feverish child immediately.
See the ankle first since he waited longer.
Take a coffee break first.
selection.expected: See the feverish child immediately.

selection.state: You are Noor, a kindergarten teacher. Goal: keep the class calm after lunch. Feeling: warm; doing: reading a story. Recent events: 1. Two kids started arguing over a crayon. 2. The rest of the class is listening quietly.
candidates: Pause and help the two kids share the crayons.
Ignore the argument and keep reading louder.
Send both kids to the principal.
selection.expected: Pause and help the two kids share the crayons.

selection.state: You are Captain Reyes, a ship captain. Goal: reach port before the storm. Feeling: tense; doing: studying the radar. Recent events: 1. A storm cell is moving faster than forecast. 2. The engine is running at full capacity.
candidates: Alter course to skirt the storm cell.
Hold course and hope the forecast is wrong.
Drop anchor in open water.
selection.expected: Alter course to skirt the storm cell.

selection.state: You are Bea, a florist. Goal: finish the wedding bouquet by noon. Feeling: creative; doing: arranging peonies. Recent events: 1. The peonies arrived wilted. 2. The bride is already anxious about the flowers.
candidates: Call the bride, suggest roses instead, and rework the bouquet.
Deliver the wilted bouquet as-is.
Cancel the order.
selection.expected: Call the bride, suggest roses instead, and rework the bouquet.

selection.state: You are Ivan, a chess grandmaster's second. Goal: find the novelty for tomorrow's game. Feeling: curious; doing: analyzing with an engine. Recent events: 1. The engine suggests a wild pawn sacrifice. 2. The opponent is known for sharp tactical play.
candidates: Flag the sacrifice line for deeper overnight analysis.
Discard it as too risky.
Play it blindly tomorrow.
selection.expected: Flag the sacrifice line for deeper overnight analysis.

selection.state: You are Tess, a barista's apprentice. Goal: learn the craft. Feeling: eager; doing: watching the head barista. Recent events: 1. A regular asked for their usual. 2. Tess does not remember the recipe.
candidates: Ask the head barista quietly for the recipe.
Guess the recipe and hope.
Tell the customer you cannot make it.
selection.expected: Ask the head barista quietly for the recipe.

selection.state: You are Ash, a park ranger. Goal: keep hikers safe. Feeling: alert; doing: patrolling the ridge trail. Recent events: 1. Dark clouds are gathering over the peak. 2. A family with small kids is heading up.
candidates: Turn the family back and warn them about the storm.
Let them continue; the clouds may pass.
Follow them silently.
selection.expected: Turn the family back and warn them about the storm.

selection.state: You are Dr. Patel, a veterinarian. Goal: diagnose the limping labrador. Feeling: gentle; doing: examining the dog's paw. Recent events: 1. The owner says the limp started after a hike. 2. The dog flinches when the pad is touched.
candidates: Check for a thorn or cut in the pad.
Order a full-body MRI immediately.
Prescribe rest without examining further.
selection.expected: Check for a thorn or cut in the pad.

selection.state: You are Zed, a street musician. Goal: earn enough for dinner. Feeling: hopeful; doing: tuning his guitar. Recent events: 1. A crowd is gathering near the fountain. 2. Another musician just left the good spot.
candidates: Take the good spot and start with an upbeat song.
Wait an hour out of politeness.
Pack up and go home.
selection.expected: Take the good spot and start with an upbeat song.

selection.state: You are Mayor Quinn. Goal: calm the town after the factory closure. Feeling: grave; doing: preparing a speech. Recent events: 1. Two hundred jobs were lost this morning. 2. Protesters are gathering outside.
candidates: Address the crowd honestly about retraining funds.
Cancel the speech and hide.
Blame the factory owners publicly.
selection.expected: Address the crowd honestly about retraining funds.

selection.state: You are Pip, a junior reporter. Goal: file the story by 6 PM. Feeling: rushed; doing: transcribing an interview. Recent events: 1. A source just called with a contradictory claim. 2. Her editor wants the draft in one hour.
candidates: Verify the claim with a second source before filing.
File immediately with the contradiction as fact.
Drop the contradictory claim silently.
selection.expected: Verify the claim with a second source before filing.

selection.state: You are Hana, a sushi chef. Goal: serve the omakase course. Feeling: precise; doing: slicing tuna. Recent events: 1. A diner is allergic to shellfish. 2. The next course traditionally includes shrimp.
candidates: Substitute the shrimp course for the allergic diner.
Serve the shrimp anyway; allergies are exaggerated.
Skip the diner entirely.
selection.expected: Substitute the shrimp course for the allergic diner.

selection.state: You are Dez, a rideshare driver. Goal: keep a 5-star rating. Feeling: friendly; doing: greeting a new passenger. Recent events: 1. The passenger looks upset and is on a work call. 2. The radio is playing loudly.
candidates: Lower the radio and stay quiet during the call.
Strike up a cheerful conversation.
Ask the passenger to end the call.
selection.expected: Lower the radio and stay quiet during the call.

selection.state: You are Vera, a museum curator. Goal: protect the new exhibit. Feeling: protective; doing: watching the gallery. Recent events: 1. A visitor is reaching toward a fragile vase. 2. The docent is on break.
candidates: Step in politely and ask the visitor not to touch.
Shout at the visitor across the room.
Pretend not to see.
selection.expected: Step in politely and ask the visitor not to touch.

selection.state: You are Sol, a lifeguard. Goal: keep swimmers safe. Feeling: vigilant; doing: scanning the pool. Recent events: 1. A child is struggling near the deep end. 2. Two teens are roughhousing in the shallow end.
candidates: Dive in to reach the struggling child.
Yell at the teens first.
Wait to see if the child recovers.
selection.expected: Dive in to reach the struggling child.

selection.state: You are Imani, a nurse. Goal: comfort the worried family. Feeling: compassionate; doing: standing outside the ICU. Recent events: 1. The surgery ran long but went well. 2. The family has been waiting six hours.
candidates: Update the family now with the good news.
Wait for the surgeon to do it tomorrow.
Avoid the family to dodge questions.
selection.expected: Update the family now with the good news.

selection.state: You are Bram, a blacksmith. Goal: finish the horseshoes by dusk. Feeling: steady; doing: hammering iron. Recent events: 1. The forge is running low on coal. 2. A traveler offers double pay for an urgent repair.
candidates: Finish the promised horseshoes first, then take the repair.
Abandon the horseshoes for the higher pay.
Refuse the traveler rudely.
selection.expected: Finish the promised horseshoes first, then take the repair.

selection.state: You are Cleo, a detective. Goal: solve the gallery theft. Feeling: suspicious; doing: interviewing the guard. Recent events: 1. The guard's story changed twice. 2. The security footage has a 10-minute gap.
candidates: Press the guard on the inconsistencies.
Accept the story and leave.
Arrest the guard on the spot.
selection.expected: Press the guard on the inconsistencies.

selection.state: You are Finn, a sailing instructor. Goal: teach the tack safely. Feeling: encouraging; doing: on a dinghy with a nervous student. Recent events: 1. The wind just gusted hard. 2. The student froze on the tiller.
candidates: Calmly take the tiller and talk through the gust.
Yell at the student to react faster.
Capsize drill immediately.
selection.expected: Calmly take the tiller and talk through the gust.

selection.state: You are Greta, a baker. Goal: have croissants ready by 7 AM. Feeling: tired; doing: laminating dough at 4 AM. Recent events: 1. The oven thermostat seems off. 2. Yesterday's batch burned.
candidates: Test the oven with a thermometer before baking.
Bake anyway and hope.
Serve yesterday's burned batch.
selection.expected: Test the oven with a thermometer before baking.

selection.state: You are Hugo, a hotel concierge. Goal: delight the guests. Feeling: polished; doing: at the front desk. Recent events: 1. A couple's anniversary dinner reservation was lost. 2. The restaurant is fully booked.
candidates: Call the restaurant manager to squeeze them in.
Tell the couple nothing can be done.
Offer them a vending-machine snack.
selection.expected: Call the restaurant manager to squeeze them in.

selection.state: You are Iris, a software intern. Goal: fix the bug before standup. Feeling: determined; doing: reading a stack trace. Recent events: 1. The bug is in a module she has never touched. 2. Standup is in 20 minutes.
candidates: Ask a teammate for a quick pointer on the module.
Rewrite the whole module from scratch.
Hide the bug and say it is fixed.
selection.expected: Ask a teammate for a quick pointer on the module.

selection.state: You are Jax, a bike courier. Goal: deliver the package on time. Feeling: hurried; doing: stopped at a red light. Recent events: 1. The delivery is already 10 minutes late. 2. The intersection is busy.
candidates: Wait for the green; text the recipient about the delay.
Run the red light to make up time.
Abandon the delivery.
selection.expected: Wait for the green; text the recipient about the delay.

selection.state: You are Kira, a zookeeper. Goal: feed the penguins. Feeling: cheerful; doing: carrying a bucket of fish. Recent events: 1. One penguin is limping. 2. Feeding time is now.
candidates: Feed the flock, then report the limping penguin to the vet.
Skip feeding to chase the limping one.
Ignore the limp entirely.
selection.expected: Feed the flock, then report the limping penguin to the vet.

selection.state: You are Leo, a wedding photographer. Goal: capture the ceremony. Feeling: focused; doing: checking his batteries. Recent events: 1. The bride is walking down the aisle in two minutes. 2. His main battery is at 5 percent.
candidates: Swap to the spare battery now.
Shoot until it dies mid-ceremony.
Ask the guests to use their phones.
selection.expected: Swap to the spare battery now.

selection.state: You are Mona, a librarian. Goal: keep the reading room quiet. Feeling: serene; doing: shelving books. Recent events: 1. A patron is taking a loud phone call. 2. Others are glaring.
candidates: Approach quietly and point to the phone zone.
Shush loudly across the room.
Eject the patron immediately.
selection.expected: Approach quietly and point to the phone zone.

selection.state: You are Ned, a night auditor. Goal: close the books by 6 AM. Feeling: drowsy; doing: reconciling receipts. Recent events: 1. A $200 discrepancy appeared. 2. His shift ends in 30 minutes.
candidates: Trace the discrepancy before clocking out.
Write it off and go home.
Blame the evening shift in the log.
selection.expected: Trace the discrepancy before clocking out.

selection.state: You are Olive, a gardener. Goal: save the roses. Feeling: worried; doing: inspecting spotted leaves. Recent events: 1. Black spot is spreading fast. 2. Rain is forecast tomorrow.
candidates: Prune the infected leaves and apply fungicide today.
Wait to see if the rain washes it off.
Pull out all the roses.
selection.expected: Prune the infected leaves and apply fungicide today.

selection.state: You are Pax, a mediator. Goal: settle the noise dispute. Feeling: neutral; doing: sitting between two neighbors. Recent events: 1. Both sides interrupted each other twice. 2. One neighbor just raised their voice.
candidates: Set a speaking order and restate the ground rules.
Let them shout it out.
Declare one side the winner.
selection.expected: Set a speaking order and restate the ground rules.

selection.state: You are Quinn, a pilot. Goal: land safely. Feeling: calm; doing: on final approach. Recent events: 1. A warning light for the landing gear flickered. 2. The tower asked for an immediate landing.
candidates: Go around and troubleshoot the gear.
Land anyway and hope.
Ignore the tower.
selection.expected: Go around and troubleshoot the gear.

selection.state: You are Rosa, a tailor. Goal: finish the suit by Friday. Feeling: meticulous; doing: pinning a hem. Recent events: 1. The client gained weight since measuring. 2. The fabric is expensive and limited.
candidates: Call the client for a re-measure before cutting.
Cut to the old measurements.
Guess the new size.
selection.expected: Call the client for a re-measure before cutting.

selection.state: You are Sam, a camp counselor. Goal: keep the kids safe on the hike. Feeling: responsible; doing: leading the group. Recent events: 1. One kid is lagging and looks pale. 2. The trail gets steep ahead.
candidates: Stop, check on the pale kid, and slow the pace.
Push on; the kid is probably fine.
Send the kid back alone.
selection.expected: Stop, check on the pale kid, and slow the pace.

selection.state: You are Tilda, a radio host. Goal: keep the show lively. Feeling: energetic; doing: interviewing a shy author. Recent events: 1. The author gives one-word answers. 2. A caller is waiting on line two.
candidates: Ask an open question about the author's favorite scene.
Cut to the caller and abandon the interview.
Fill the silence with her own monologue.
selection.expected: Ask an open question about the author's favorite scene.

selection.state: You are Umar, a plumber. Goal: fix the burst pipe. Feeling: practical; doing: under the sink. Recent events: 1. Water is still flowing. 2. The homeowner is panicking.
candidates: Shut off the main valve first, then repair.
Try to patch it while water flows.
Tell the homeowner to call someone else.
selection.expected: Shut off the main valve first, then repair.

selection.state: You are Vesper, a sommelier. Goal: pair the wine. Feeling: confident; doing: tasting the sauce. Recent events: 1. The dish is spicier than the menu says. 2. The guest hates oaky wines.
candidates: Recommend an off-dry riesling instead of the planned chardonnay.
Pour the oaky chardonnay anyway.
Skip the pairing.
selection.expected: Recommend an off-dry riesling instead of the planned chardonnay.

selection.state: You are Wade, a firefighter. Goal: clear the building. Feeling: focused; doing: at the stairwell door. Recent events: 1. Smoke is thick on the third floor. 2. A resident says her cat is still inside.
candidates: Sweep the floor for people first; animals second.
Search for the cat before sweeping.
Wait outside for backup.
selection.expected: Sweep the floor for people first; animals second.

judge.actionText: Anton walks over to the whiteboard.
Dana says to Mira: The deadline moved to Friday.
Mira hands Anton a cup of coffee.
Anton runs to the door, shouting for help.
Dana sits back down and resumes typing.
Mira walks to Dana and whispers: Did you hear about the layoffs?
Anton nods thoughtfully at the proposal.
Dana storms out of the room.
Mira announces to everyone: Lunch is ready in the kitchen!
Anton shakes Dana's hand warmly.
Dana paces around the table, muttering about the budget.
Mira picks up the phone and calls the supplier.
Anton walks to Mira's desk to ask about the report.
Dana stares out the window in silence.
Mira taps Anton on the shoulder and points at the screen.
Anton declares: I quit! and heads for the exit.
Dana returns to her chair and keeps working.
Mira asks Dana: Can you cover my shift tomorrow?
Anton wanders aimlessly around the lobby.
Dana hugs Mira tightly.
Mira jogs to the park entrance to meet the group.
Theo tells June: The trail is closed past the ridge.
June waves at Theo from across the meadow.
Mira sits on the bench and eats her sandwich.
Theo walks June to the fountain, explaining the route.
June shouts: Watch out for the cyclist!
Mira goes back to the trailhead to fetch water.
Theo high-fives Mira after the climb.
June whispers to Mira: I think we're lost.
Mira stands up and stretches.
Kai slides the pizza into the oven.
Bea carries the tray to the dining room.
Sam asks Bea: Is the pizza ready yet?
Kai wipes his hands and goes back to kneading dough.
Bea rushes to the oven, yelling: It's burning!
Sam pats Kai on the back: Nice save.
Kai walks Sam to the door at closing time.
Bea hums while arranging the tables.
Sam leaves a generous tip on the counter and waves goodbye.
Kai calls out to Bea across the kitchen: Fire the next one!

triage.event: Dana slammed the door and shouted that she quits.
Anton refilled his water glass at the cooler.
Mira quietly resumed typing after lunch.
The fire alarm went off and everyone evacuated the building.
Theo mentioned the meeting moved to 3 PM.
June announced her engagement to the whole office.
Anton adjusted his chair height.
A stranger walked in, looked around slowly, and left without a word.
Mira sneezed twice during the standup.
The CEO unexpectedly walked into the open office.
Dana whispered a joke to Mira and both giggled.
The printer jammed for the third time today.
Anton's code deleted the production database by accident.
Mira made a fresh pot of coffee.
Theo received a phone call and his face went pale.
June watered the office plants.
Two coworkers started arguing loudly about the thermostat.
Anton saved his document and closed the laptop.
Dana was promoted to team lead, effective immediately.
The elevator dinged and the doors opened.
Mira found a wallet on the floor and turned it in.
Theo restocked the paper trays.
A window shattered during the hailstorm.
June hummed while filing papers.
Anton confessed he lost the client's USB drive.
The lights flickered briefly.
Dana burst into tears at her desk.
Mira checked the time on her phone.
Theo proposed a new workflow and the team applauded.
June locked the office door at the end of the day.
